page.overview:
Who is Abby (Gas Station)?

Aaron was the helicopter pilot of the Black Stream, sent by The Hood to eliminate the Punisher, but seeing the bad situation, the leader of the Black Stream fled, radioing Aaron to start the helicopter to escape, but as soon as he arrived in the helicopter the leader found Aaron dead and connected to a bomb that exploded, killing the leader.

Abby was Nigel Frobisher's secretary. [http://www.marvunapp.com/Appendix6/frobishernigel.htm#Abby Abby on the Marvel Appendix]

Abby was a prostitute whose body was possessed by the spirit of a Wicca belonging to the ancient Celtic tribe of the Iceni who woke up when Satana arrived in London, convinced that she was the mighty matriarch they had been waiting for and that would guide them.

Abby was an eccentric painter who worked in large-scale abstracts, usually motion studies and post-figurative imagery.
